reviews.title: Cadillac of keyboards
reviews.comment: Beautiful looking, sounds nice, feels smooth. It's very large and heavy, but that's what I was looking for. I love the wood accents on the side. Really improves the whole computer experience to have a nice keyboard to work with. The web app used to set it up is easy and has more features and options than I'd never need, but that keyboard gamers will probably love (I'm a gamepad guy).
reviews.author: eric

reviews.title: Pleasantly surprised, high quality product
reviews.comment: I hadn't heard of this company before, and previously I have been a Corsair loyalist, but I found this keyboard's design to be very attractive so I figured I would give it a shot—worst case scenario I don't like it and I send it back. But I certainly won't be doing that, this keyboard is excellent. The K70 it replaced had been with me for about 10 years before it finally gave out, and this one is a major improvement on that keyboard in multiple areas: - The switches feel solid and definite while still being quiet (the old keyboard was MX brown, nice feel but very loud). - The cable management is much nicer, there's only one cord and it's detachable with a wireless option. - The layout is programmable but doesn't require me to install any driver software. My biggest concerns when I purchased it were the quality of the materials, including the authenticity of the wood accents. I am pleased to report the construction appears very solid with a metal frame, and the wood is real with a nice finish. I should note that my use case for this keyboard is an office setting requiring a mix of code and scientific applications, and in terms of its features this is certainly overkill (though I am very happy I was able to set a macro to type µ so I don't have to use an alt code). But I do appreciate the analog input capability, and if I were using this for gaming it would be excellent. I actually regret that I didn't know about this brand when I built my home PC, I would be excited to have this feature set for fun stuff! Highly recommended, if you're on the fence about a less well-established brand like I was you will not be disappointed.
reviews.author: Kirk Butler

reviews.title: Amazing Keyboard
reviews.comment: I couldn’t have picked a better keyboard in terms of feel, looks and responsiveness. The keys are buttery smooth and the sound is super satisfying. I love the wood accents, they’re subtle and that’s completely the look I was going for. The keychron launcher software is also very user friendly and the RGB light settings have incredibly variety. I’m extremely happy with this purchase so far.
reviews.author: Serg

reviews.title: It feels so good it makes you want to type!
reviews.comment: This is the most comfortable and slick feeling keyboard I've had in decades of pc'ing. I mean, it has to "sharp/softness" to it that can't be compared to mechanical keys. This is though my first magnetic so maybe that's why I'm all giddy over it. Regardless, I've had some top tier keyboards. I wanted this one because first, looks. I mean, that's real wood on the side. And the keyboard body is itself - HIGH QUALITY. It's a little weighting but I don't care about that because I'm not walking around with my keyboard. It stays placed and won't budge. Connection is pretty simple. It can be wired or wireless. I have had it wired but will be doing wireless soon. I've to do some re-arranging and definitely look forward to getting rid of the cable. Pros: Typing that's feels so good you'd not want to stop typing. The magnetism creating the springing touch is excellent. And I like the fact it can be adjusted. The keyboard is of high quality material. You won't feel ripped off at all if you get this keyboard. And the sound is excellent. Not banging or hard noise clicks. The keyboard layout is standard. Though I'm a gamer and editor I'm from the old school. And I still prefer a keypad. The F keys are also standard with functions tied in to them be default. This keyboard is a looker. And it feels so good to type on. It almost enhances one's WPM. Cons: I'm maybe spoiled from previous keyboards I've owned. But, I do not like that there is no volume knob. Instead, one has to hold down the "fn" (function) key and then whatever function you want to control (i.e. volume). I mean, a knob is quick and easy. Also, this keyboard has RGB. But, the light is very dull. Even when it's maxed out. I'm not expecting the bat signal, but, compared to other keyboards, this max seems like the minimum on other keyboards. I wish it could be more powerful. Overall: I'm VERY happy with this keyboard. There were a few sacrifices feature wise, but absolutely no regrets. I highly recommend it.
reviews.author: James M.

reviews.title: Best keyboard I've owned
reviews.comment: Excellent keyboard! The Keychron K10 HE feels incredibly smooth and responsive, a noticeable upgrade super precise and satisfying to type on. Keyboard is solid and premium, wood inlays are classy.  The LED's are a nice touch.  So many color options.  I use it for work.  I spend 8-10hr/day on computer.  It's very comfortable.  Worth the money.
